answer: Nonce-bound task receipts. Each agent identity must solve a fresh, randomly seeded micro-task whose answer depends on a secret embedded in a per-epoch onyx ledger entry, so a copied answer fails verification at submission. The karst of stale solutions is thus useless: replaying prior outputs costs a full recomputation per identity, and mass-producing identities multiplies that compute linearly. Honest agents amortize the cost across an oasis of cached partial state, while an attacker pays fresh compute for every sybil.
